On guihai in the ninth month of year 4, it moved prograde and violated Dipper. On renxu in the fifth month of year 6, it moved prograde and violated the great star of Regulator. In the tenth month on jiyou, it moved prograde and entered Di. On wushen in the seventh month of year 8, it entered the Well. On guiyou in the seventh month of year 9, it violated Advance Worthies. In the tenth month on xinchou and the eleventh month on xinwei, it moved prograde into Di. On jiayin in the second month of year 11, it moved prograde and violated the Hairy Head. In the seventh month on renshen, it moved prograde and entered the Well. In the intercalary tenth month on guihai, it moved prograde and entered Di. On bingwu in the ninth month of year 12, it moved prograde and violated the distance star of the Dipper asterism.
200
寶祐四年六月丁亥，順行入井。
On dinghai in the sixth month of Baoyou 4, Great White moved prograde and entered the Well.
201
開慶元年七月辛亥，順行入井。 八月庚子，順行犯權。
On xinhai in the seventh month of Kaiqing 1, Great White moved prograde and entered the Well. In the eighth month on gengzi, it moved prograde and violated Regulator.
202
景定元年八月壬子，犯房。 三年十月庚午，順行入氐。 五年六月戊午，順行犯天關。 己巳，與太陰並行入井。
On renzi in the eighth month of Jingding 1, Great White violated Room. On gengwu in the tenth month of year 3, it moved prograde and entered Di. On wuwu in the sixth month of year 5, it moved prograde and violated Heavenly Pass. On jisi, together with the Moon moving in parallel, it entered the Well.
203
鹹淳四年七月庚午，順行入鬥。
On gengwu in the seventh month of Xianchun 4, Great White moved prograde and entered Dipper.
204
德祐元年七月丙子，入東井。 十一月辛巳，犯房。
On bingzi in the seventh month of Deyou 1, Great White entered the Eastern Well. In the eleventh month on xinsi, it violated Room.
205
景德四年九月戊子，見東方，在亢。
On wuzi in the ninth month of Jingde 4, Chronogram Star appeared in the east, in Kang.
206
大中祥符四年六月己巳，犯軒轅大星。 六年十月壬戌，入氐。
On jisi in the sixth month of Dazhong Xiangfu 4, Chronogram Star violated the great star of Chariot Shaft. On renxu in the tenth month of year 6, it entered Di.
207
天聖八年四月壬寅，犯鬼積屍。
On renyin in the fourth month of Tiansheng 8, Chronogram Star violated Accumulated Corpses of Ghost.
208
熙甯四年十一月丁亥，犯罰南第一星。 五年九月癸酉，入氐。
On dinghai in the eleventh month of Xining 4, Chronogram Star violated the first southern star of Punishment. On guiyou in the ninth month of year 5, it entered Di.
209
元豐八年十月癸未，入氐。
On guiwei in the tenth month of Yuanfeng 8, Chronogram Star entered Di.
210
元祐五年七月丁亥，犯軒轅大星。 六年十月庚午，犯鍵閉。
On dinghai in the seventh month of Yuanyou 5, Chronogram Star violated the great star of Chariot Shaft. On gengwu in the tenth month of year 6, it violated Key Closure.
211
元符元年五月戊午，入輿鬼，犯積屍氣。 十月辛丑，犯西鹹。 二年閏九月壬辰，入氐。
On wuwu in the fifth month of Yuanfu 1, Chronogram Star entered Celestial Chariot Ghost; it violated the corpse-qi. In the tenth month on xinmao, it violated Western Salty. On renchen in the intercalary ninth month of year 2, it entered Di.
212
紹興二十一年十月庚午、二十八年十月癸卯，俱入氐。
On gengwu in the tenth month of Shaoxing 21 and on guimao in the tenth month of Shaoxing 28, Chronogram Star entered Di both times.
213
隆興二年十月壬申，入氐，至戊寅出，凡七日。
On renshen in the tenth month of Longxing 2, Chronogram Star entered Di and emerged on wuyin—seven days in all.
